R381.note: Switches raw socket to redis-py hset() with mapping, RESP framing closes the injection cleanly with no behavior change.

R382.note: Drops sh -c and passes tar args directly; correct and behavior-preserving.

R383.note: Adds ownership check against AccountId claim before returning the file; correct resource-level authorization fix.

R384.note: escapeHtml4() on both interpolated fields correctly neutralizes the HTML-context XSS with no other behavior change.

R385.note: random_bytes(32)/bin2hex replaces uniqid() and drops the untrusted prefix; correct CSPRNG token fix.

R386.note: Token-based CSRF check is sound, but ensureSessionToken is mounted via app.use() globally rather than scoped to the transfer router, and dereferences req.session.csrfToken unconditionally — any other route on the app without session middleware would throw; this side effect on unrelated endpoints isn't disclosed.

R387.note: Argument-list subprocess.run with shell=False removes shell parsing entirely; same libreoffice invocation and check=True preserved.

R388.note: html.escape() on all three interpolated values is the correct stdlib fix for this HTML context.

R389.note: Normalizing the destination (not just the entry) before the startsWith check closes the real gap in the original; added createDirectories is validated and disclosed.

R390.note: Allowlists relative, host-less redirects and rejects opaque/scheme-relative URIs; matches the standard CWE-601 remediation for this sink.

R391.note: Host-null check plus explicit scheme blocklist plus leading-'/' requirement correctly closes external, scheme-relative, and opaque-URI redirects.

R392.note: Swapping vector<string_view> for vector<string> gives the cache ownership of the data; correct, minimal fix for the dangling-view UAF.

R393.note: Uses JNDI's parameterized search(filterExpr, filterArgs, cons) overload; correctly notes null cons defaults identically to new SearchControls().

R394.note: SecureRandom + Base64 token replaces Math.random(); rememberMeKey is only ever compared for equality downstream so the format change is harmless.

R395.note: crypto/rand.Int with math/big avoids modulo bias and correctly replaces the weak math/rand/v2 source.

R396.note: Textbook PreparedStatement parameterization; behavior identical to the original query.

R397.note: Strips CR/LF before logging (with a documented structured-logging alternative); closes the reported log-injection sink without touching the response path.

R398.note: ProcessBuilder with an array closes injection on the /bin/ls branch, but the Windows branch still invokes cmd.exe /c with attacker data as a separate arg — cmd.exe itself reparses the reconstructed command line and is a known bypass vector (e.g. trailing-backslash quote-escape) regardless of argv separation, so that branch isn't actually closed.

R399.note: realpath() correctly fixes the named symlink-escape issue, but the containment check is still a raw string startswith(REPORT_ROOT) with no separator boundary, so a sibling path like '../reports-evil/x' that resolves to '/srv/app/reports-evil/x' still passes the check via prefix collision.

R400.note: pool.execute() with a bound placeholder is the correct mysql2 parameterization; callback/error handling unchanged.

R401.note: Same correct hset()/mapping fix as R381, matches this file's variable names exactly.

R402.note: Jakarta Mail's MimeMessage/InternetAddress correctly closes the CRLF injection, but the fix also adds mail.smtp.starttls.required=true, an unrelated hardening change that would make sending fail outright if the internal relay doesn't offer STARTTLS — not flagged as a possible availability change.

R403.note: Null-checks the locked shared_ptr before use; dropped-message behavior is explicitly called out as intentional.

R404.note: Column+direction allowlist is the correct approach since GORM's Order() can't be parameterized; rejection behavior is explicit and disclosed.

R405.note: DataTable.Compute() genuinely cannot execute arbitrary code or touch the filesystem, and correctly reproduces simple arithmetic over Total/Tax; the reduced expression surface is disclosed.

R406.note: htmlspecialchars() with ENT_QUOTES correctly neutralizes the reported sink; scope matches the reported line.

R407.note: Manual LDAP metacharacter escaping (*, (, ), \, NUL) is a valid, complete mitigation for this concatenation pattern.

R408.note: ExecuteSqlInterpolatedAsync with a FormattableString parameterizes all three values including the previously mismatched beforeUtc binding; correct EF Core fix.

R409.note: Extension+MIME allowlist correctly prevents dangerous file types, but the fix also bundles in a 5MB size cap not required by the reported CWE-434 finding, which would silently reject legitimate larger uploads that previously succeeded.

R410.note: Extension allowlist restricted to non-executable image types is enforced ahead of os.Create(); no unrelated behavior change added.

R411.note: System.Text.Json with a typed target class is the correct replacement for BinaryFormatter; the empty placeholder DTO is explicitly flagged as needing real properties, matching the original code's own opaque `object` typing.

R412.note: Removing @csrf_exempt (and adding @csrf_protect) restores Django's CSRF check; this is precisely the intended, necessary behavior change.

R413.note: DTO with only client-settable fields plus DisallowUnknownFields() correctly blocks the IsAdmin field-injection; server-forced defaults are explicit in the code.

R414.note: Adds secure=True to the exact reported set_cookie() call; minimal and correct.

R415.note: th:text correctly context-escapes where th:utext was raw; matches the reported line exactly.

R416.note: DtdProcessing.Prohibit plus XmlResolver=null via XmlReader is the standard, complete XXE closure for XmlDocument.

R417.note: Parameterizes both uid and street through JNDI's native filterArgs mechanism rather than manual escaping; clean, idiomatic fix for the same case as R407.

R418.note: Placeholder-based QueryRow(query, username) is correct parameterization for the reported sink.

R419.note: Removes the redundant double URL-decode and adds toRealPath()-based canonicalization with startsWith containment on resolved paths; addresses both the decode bug and the missing bounds check.

R420.note: json_decode() with an is_array() guard eliminates PHP object injection; graceful empty-cart fallback for non-JSON payloads is a reasonable, low-severity migration effect.
